crossRefs.note: The border went down to the brook of Kanah, southward of the brook. These cities belonged to Ephraim among the cities…

people.name: Ephraim
people.line: Second son of Joseph, and a tribe of Israel.

people.name: Manasseh
people.line: Firstborn son of Joseph, blessed by Jacob.

translations.web: together with the cities which were set apart for the children of Ephraim in the middle of the inheritance of the children of Manasseh, all the cities with their villages.
translations.bsb: along with all the cities and villages set apart for the descendants of Ephraim within the inheritance of Manasseh.
translations.kjv: And the separate cities for the children of Ephraim were among the inheritance of the children of Manasseh, all the cities with their villages.
translations.asv: together with the cities which were set apart for the children of Ephraim in the midst of the inheritance of the children of Manasseh, all the cities with their villages.
